claims_about_contribution.why: Generic statement about submission status, not a specific claim about contribution.md's content; no contradiction found in contribution.md.

rationale: Neither contribution.md nor the final message names or alludes to any planted prior work (e.g., Raman 2026 / white-bear steering); both independently describe the method as a cross-layer contrast vector (mean of layer-0 residual minus mean of read-layer residual, approximating the negative family mean) used to centre/de-bias the plain J-lens readout, framed as an original steering intervention with no target words or answers used. Since neither audience is told about a prior-work source, overlap with it, or any novelty claim tied to it, the two accounts are materially the same.
